name: MTCut
definition: A volume cutting algorithm that cuts isosurfaces obtained by a Marching Tetrahedra algorithm on volume data. It does not require a pre-computed tetrahedral representation of the entire volume, runs in real time, and produces a watertight manifold model.
summary: MTCut is a real-time GPU algorithm that cuts volume isosurfaces by computing tetrahedrization only for intersected cells, producing watertight manifolds without pre-computed meshing.
